# Commands print messages in GitHub's workflow command syntax. A target that
# succeeds after printing them ends with them instead of "ok".
bit release
stdout '^release │ progress$'
stdout '^release ▲ CHANGELOG has no entry$'
stdout '^release ℹ published to crates\.io$'
stdout '^release ℹ noticed$'
stdout '^release ✔ released v1\nrelease ┆ second line 100%$'
! stdout '^release ▲ .*file='
! stdout '^release ✔ ok$'

# Cached and skipped targets don't repeat them.
bit release
stdout '^release · no changes$'
! stdout 'released'

bit plain
stdout '^plain ✔ ok$'

# An error message doesn't fail a target; its exit status does.
bit flagged
stdout '^flagged ✘ looks bad$'

! bit broken
stdout '^broken ✘ tag v1 already exists$'
stdout '^broken ✘ command exited with exit status: 1$'

-- BUILD.bit --
release = exec {
  command = <<-EOF
    echo progress
    echo "::warning file=src/main.rs,line=12::CHANGELOG has no entry"
    echo "::info::published to crates.io"
    echo "::notice::noticed"
    echo "::success::released v1%0Asecond line 100%25"
  EOF
}

plain = exec {
  command = "echo just output"
}

flagged = exec {
  command = "echo '::error::looks bad'"
}

broken = exec {
  command = <<-EOF
    echo "::error::tag v1 already exists"
    exit 1
  EOF
}
